browser: Headless Chrome via tracked Playwright wrapper
checks: Manufacturer model ready; front-ring button, rotating-ring encoder and screen hit areas produce green, blue and red hover overlays.
Original official factory image loaded using the local-file UI; actual ROM boot displays LCD TEST launcher.
Mouse press on front ring enters LCD TEST; drag on rotating ring changes the firmware-generated test pattern.
Touch on the rendered screen draws a blue point; keyboard A exits LCD TEST to launcher.
2D and 3D show the same firmware output. Gold opaque metal and purple translucent plastic preserve the screen and control operation.
A generated embed share URL auto-starts official UIFlow2 without a start click; its 240x240 offline screen is visible.
retention: Raw screenshots are ignored and not published; UIFlow output contains an emulated device identifier. Retained hashes identify the reviewed originals.
limitations: No real hardware check and no wireless connection claim. The mini check used direct embed navigation, not a cross-origin parent RPC.
The wait script initially queried an absent top-level timeMicros field, so it waited its 55-second limit; the final observation uses stats.time=54.02 and confirms a running guest before pausing.
